# Tools

<!-- Generated by scripts/tool_docs.py from the registered tools. Do not edit by hand. -->

39 tools, 25 of them read-only. Tools that change anything are registered only with `OITC_ENABLE_WRITE_TOOLS=true`.

**Size** is the definition a model receives with every request - name, description and input schema as compact JSON - in characters. Roughly 3.1 to 3.7 characters make one token; see [tool-design.md](tool-design.md).

## `triage`

What is broken, since when, whether it is already handled, and whether the monitoring itself is at fault.

12 tools, 9465 characters.

| Tool | Effect | Parameters | Size | What it is for |
|---|---|---|---:|---|
| `get_host_info` | reads | `hostname` | 843 | Detailed status of a host plus the services running on it. |
| `get_monitoring_engine_stats` | reads | - | 442 | Health of the monitoring engine itself: how many hosts and services it watches, and its check throughput and latency. |
| `list_host_acknowledgements` | reads | `hostname`, `limit?` | 823 | Acknowledgement history for one host: who acknowledged a problem, when, and with what comment. |
| `list_host_checks` | reads | `hostname`, `hours?`, `limit?` | 817 | Individual check executions for a host, newest first: output, latency and execution time per run. |
| `list_host_downtimes` | reads | `hostname?`, `only_active?`, `limit?` | 711 | Scheduled and running downtimes for hosts. |
| `list_host_state_changes` | reads | `hostname`, `hours?`, `limit?` | 722 | Only the entries where a host's state changed, i.e. the timeline of an incident rather than every check run. |
| `list_log_entries` | reads | `hours?`, `limit?` | 550 | Host and service alert log entries from the last `hours` hours, newest first. |
| `list_service_acknowledgements` | reads | `hostname`, `servicename`, `limit?` | 912 | Acknowledgement history for one service: who acknowledged a problem, when, and with what comment. |
| `list_service_checks` | reads | `hostname`, `servicename`, `hours?`, `limit?` | 1191 | Individual check executions for a service, newest first: output, latency and execution time per run. |
| `list_service_downtimes` | reads | `hostname?`, `servicename?`, `only_active?`, `limit?` | 802 | Scheduled and running downtimes for services. |
| `list_service_state_changes` | reads | `hostname`, `servicename`, `hours?`, `limit?` | 925 | Only the entries where a service's state changed. |
| `list_services_by_state` | reads | `state`, `limit?` | 727 | Services currently in a given state. |

## `catalog`

Look up what exists - templates, commands, contacts, groups, containers - without changing anything.

9 tools, 4429 characters.

| Tool | Effect | Parameters | Size | What it is for |
|---|---|---|---:|---|
| `get_container_tree` | reads | `container_name?` | 484 | Get the organizational structure (containers: tenants, locations, nodes) starting at the given container, including which hosts, host groups and service groups live directly under it. |
| `list_commands` | reads | `name_filter?`, `limit?` | 588 | Find monitoring commands (check, notification and event-handler commands) by name. |
| `list_contactgroups` | reads | `limit?` | 356 | List contact groups (named groups of contacts used for notifications). |
| `list_contacts` | reads | `name_filter?`, `limit?` | 529 | Find contacts (people who can be notified) by name. |
| `list_hostgroups` | reads | `limit?` | 412 | List host groups with their name and description. |
| `list_hosttemplates` | reads | `name_filter?`, `limit?` | 655 | Find host templates (reusable check/notification configurations for hosts) by name. |
| `list_servicegroups` | reads | `limit?` | 400 | List service groups with their name and description. |
| `list_servicetemplategroups` | reads | `limit?` | 402 | List service template groups (named groups of service templates, used e.g. to bulk-apply services to hosts). |
| `list_servicetemplates` | reads | `name_filter?`, `limit?` | 603 | Find service templates (reusable check/notification configurations for services) by name. |

## `onboarding`

Take a host and its services into monitoring without container-scope rejections.

8 tools, 9135 characters.

| Tool | Effect | Parameters | Size | What it is for |
|---|---|---|---:|---|
| `create_host` | **creates** | `name`, `address`, `description?`, `container_name?`, `hosttemplate_name?` | 839 | Use this function to create a new host in openITCOCKPIT. container_name defaults to the root container if not given; hosttemplate_name defaults to the built-in 'default host' template. hosttemplate_name must be visible from container_name's scope - use get_allowed_elements_for_container(object_type="host", container_name=...) to see which host templates qualify. |
| `create_host_with_agent_pull_mode` | **creates** | `name`, `address`, `description?`, `container_name?`, `hosttemplate_name?`, `port?`, `use_https?`, `basic_auth_username?`, `basic_auth_password?` | 1150 | Create a new host monitored via the openITCOCKPIT agent in Pull mode (openITCOCKPIT connects to the agent, rather than the agent pushing data). |
| `create_service` | **creates** | `hostname`, `servicetemplate_name`, `name?`, `fields?` | 2932 | Create a new service on an existing host from a service template. |
| `get_allowed_elements_for_container` | reads | `object_type`, `container_name?` | 1629 | List the host templates, contacts, contact groups, timeperiods, host groups, etc. that are actually visible from a given container - i.e. the values a Create* tool for that object_type would accept there. openITCOCKPIT restricts every such reference to the target container's own scope (the container plus its descendants, plus a few legacy tenant-wide exceptions); values outside that scope are rejected. |
| `get_container_tree` | reads | `container_name?` | 484 | Get the organizational structure (containers: tenants, locations, nodes) starting at the given container, including which hosts, host groups and service groups live directly under it. |
| `get_host_info` | reads | `hostname` | 843 | Detailed status of a host plus the services running on it. |
| `list_hosttemplates` | reads | `name_filter?`, `limit?` | 655 | Find host templates (reusable check/notification configurations for hosts) by name. |
| `list_servicetemplates` | reads | `name_filter?`, `limit?` | 603 | Find service templates (reusable check/notification configurations for services) by name. |
